summary.text: One of the earthborn Giants whom Athena flayed in the Gigantomachy and whose skin she used to shield her own body in the fight.

story.text: Apollodorus names Pallas among the Giants destroyed when Heracles fought at the gods' side: Athena flayed Pallas and used his skin to shield her own body in the fight. The revolt of the earthborn belongs to the Giants together; Pallas is one of those named in the battle roll.
This Pallas is not the Titan of that name, son of Crius and Eurybia, nor the son of Pandion so called.
